Project Feasibility & Ecosystem Sensitivity Tool

Prototype placement · ecosystem screening · feasibility scoring · adaptation · reporting
Developed by Berexford Saylee Jallah
1Project & prototype

Detailed model: rectangular museum with butterfly section, glass domes, 15-storey Peace Tower with observatory and eternal flame, crescent pools, amphitheatre, obelisk, pavilions, palms, cars. Built from the model photos; dimensions approximate.

2Area of interest (AOI)

Drawing: click to add points, double-click (or press Finish) to close. A larger AOI (e.g. the whole island) gives the adaptation step more room to find alternative positions.

3Ecosystems & data

On by default because the site is in the Mesurado Wetlands, Ramsar site no. 1631 (6,760 ha, designated 2006). Whether this parcel lies inside the listed boundary is not confirmed — upload the official boundary below to measure overlap instead.

Protection buffers

Buffers are editable planning defaults, not legal setbacks — set them to the EPA Liberia requirement for your project.

4Feasibility score

Run the analysis in step 3 to score the proposal.

Criteria weights (sum is normalised)
5Adaptation scenarios

Finds how the project could be adapted so sensitive ecosystems stay untouched: relocate/rotate within the AOI, compact the footprint, or clip it to buildable land.

6Report & export

Builds a full report with maps, 3D view, tables, score charts and recommendations. Print it or save as PDF from the report view.

Click to add AOI points · double-click to finish
